title: Check Static Gap
text: Check that gap exists in signal’s range of amplitudes, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Upper bound} sets Upper boundary value scalar; {Inclusive upper bound} sets the include the upper bound in range, {Lower bound}, {Inclusive lower bound} sets the include the lower bound in range, {Enable assertion} enables or disable check, {Simulation callback when assertion fails (optional)} sets the expression to evaluate when assertion, {Stop simulation when assertion fails} sets the whether to stop simulation when check, {Output assertion signal} sets the create output signal and {Select icon type}. Values come from the instance.
